data.headline: Ninth Circuit issues published opinion in Liu v. Kaiser Permanente Employees Pension Plan
summary: The Ninth Circuit filed a published opinion on August 31, 2026 in an ERISA benefits appeal against the Kaiser Permanente Employees Pension Plan, appeal number 24-4303.
The holding is not in the collected text; the opinion is published, so it will bind district courts in the circuit on whatever benefit-claims question it decides.
